morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，无马来语词缀；音标按所给马来语音节形式标注，保留 /l/，不套用英语通常不读 l 的读法。未列无依据的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 鲑鱼，通称三文鱼；包括大西洋鲑及太平洋鲑类等鱼，在饮食语境中也指其鱼肉。
senses.en_definition: A salmon, including Atlantic salmon and Pacific salmon species; also its flesh as food.
senses.ms_definition: Ikan daripada spesies Salmo salar atau kumpulan Oncorhynchus spp.; dalam konteks makanan, juga merujuk kepada isinya.
senses.nuances: 可单用 salmon，也可用 ikan salmon。不是所有鲑科鱼都应一概称为 salmon；食物名称本身不表示适合生食。DBP 列出 Salmo salar 与 Oncorhynchus spp.。[DBP：salmon](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=salmon)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报 / 餐饮采购
dual_scenarios.ms: Jabatan pembelian telah menerima bekalan ikan salmon untuk penyediaan menu baharu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 采购部门已收到用于制作新菜单菜品的三文鱼。
dual_scenarios.en: The purchasing department has received a supply of salmon for the new menu.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Salmon ni nak bakar je ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah ikan salmon ini hendak dibakar sahaja?
dual_scenarios.en: Are we just going to grill this salmon?
spoken_features: 句末 ke 表示口语疑问

messages.speaker: Farah (家人)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah beli salmon kat pasar raya. Nak masak apa malam ni?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah membeli ikan salmon di pasar raya. Apakah yang hendak kita masak malam ini?
messages.zh: 我已经在超市买了三文鱼。今晚怎么做？
messages.en: I bought some salmon at the supermarket. How shall we cook it tonight?

messages.speaker: Amir (家人)
messages.ms_spoken: Bakar je lah, letak lemon sikit.
messages.ms_standard: Kita bakar sahaja ikan itu dan tambahkan sedikit lemon.
messages.en: Let's just grill it with a little lemon.

etymology.historical_story: The name salmon belongs to an international naming tradition reaching English through French from Latin salmo. Its familiar spelling can hide a pronunciation difference: English usually leaves the letter l silent, whereas the supplied Malay dictionary form divides it as sal.mon. Remember the Malay pronunciation when reading Malay aloud. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/salmon), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=salmon)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 sal—mon 两拍读，把中间的 l 留住；看到 ikan salmon，就想到餐盘里的三文鱼。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性食材名称，适合菜单、采购及日常交流；向服务员点餐可说 Saya hendak memesan salmon bakar。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 请客时可询问对方喜欢的烹调方式及是否对鱼过敏；菜名中的 salmon 不说明酱汁、配料或加工方式。
